text.tspan: Threshold income per year marking the richest decile (before tax)
The level of income per year below which 90% of the population falls. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in
living costs between countries. Income here is measured before taxes and benefits.

Note: This data is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices. Income has been
equivalized
.
